rules.source: The Fund holds between 18 and 22 equally weighted positions selected from the investment universe.
No single holding may exceed 7% of the portfolio
no more than 15% of the portfolio may be invested in any one sector

rules.detail: MinGroups(at least 8 distinct sector values; 10 in the universe)
rules.source: The portfolio is spread across at least eight sectors.

rules.detail: only region in ['Nordic', 'Western Europe'] (123 assets eligible): excludes A005, A017, A022, A024, A025, A026, ... (27 assets)
rules.source: The Fund invests only in companies domiciled in the Nordic region or Western Europe.

rules.detail: at most floor(25% x 20) = 5 names in each country (10 of them)
rules.source: No more than 25% of the portfolio may be invested in companies from a single country.

rules.detail: market_cap_eur_bn below 1 (absolute 1): excludes A001, A008, A026, A125, A130, A134, ... (7 assets)
rules.source: Companies with a market capitalisation below EUR 1 billion are not eligible.

rules.detail: flag in ['tobacco', 'controversial_weapons']: excludes A024, A043, A044, A143 (4 assets)
rules.source: The Fund does not invest in companies involved in the production of tobacco or in controversial weapons.

rules.detail: flag in ['thermal_coal']: excludes A071, A080, A091 (3 assets)
rules.source: Companies that derive more than 5% of their revenue from thermal coal are excluded.

rules.detail: esg below 34.26..51.31 by sector (percentile 20): excludes A009, A020, A021, A023, A024, A027, ... (30 assets)
rules.source: Within each sector, the companies whose ESG score falls in the lowest 20% of that sector are not eligible for investment.
The average ESG score of the portfolio must be at least 5% higher than the average of the investment universe.
The portfolio's average carbon intensity must be at least 25% below that of the investment universe.
On average, women must make up at least 34% of the board members of portfolio companies.

rules.detail: CountBound(at least ceil(50% x 20) = 10 names in assets flagged sbti_target; 80 such assets)
rules.source: At least half of the portfolio is invested in companies with validated science-based emissions reduction targets.

rules.detail: A target that changes from year to year needs a time series of carbon data and a reference year; the spec describes one point in time.
rules.source: The Fund aims to reduce the carbon intensity of the portfolio by 7% each year.

rules.detail: TrackingErrorCap(tracking error <= 6.0% against the equal-weight universe)
rules.source: The expected tracking error of the portfolio against the investment universe will not exceed 6% per year.

rules.detail: The universe data has no EU Taxonomy alignment flag or field.
rules.source: At least 80% of the Fund's assets will be invested in companies whose activities are aligned with the EU Taxonomy.

rules.detail: Voting and engagement commitments do not restrict which assets may be held.
rules.source: The manager votes at all shareholder meetings and engages with investee companies on their climate transition plans.

attribution.benchmark_label: median random portfolio, k=20, no other rule
